originalTexts.10M5-0:

Foreground active views only. Coalesce one in-flight request per resolved location + dataset/date-range query across Home/Planner/Agent. Request identity changes on city/date; ignore late old responses.

originalTexts.10M7-0:

originalTexts.10LV-0:

Reserve cached exact SDK combined mark + legal URL; gray space is NOT a certified mark. Runtime hides numerical weather if attribution is missing.
Retry → loading, coalesced request +60s manual cooldown; Back restores origin draft. Home cached inline uses Saved / updated qualifier or date-only when unavailable; never fresh-looking saved data.
originalTexts.10M1-0:
